title: APPEAL/1/2026 — GANPAT RAM vs. RAJASTHAN GRAMIN BANK
text:
Office of Assistant Registrar
DEBTS RECOVERY TRIBUNAL, JAIPUR
Appeal
GANPAT RAM
V/S
RAJASTHAN GRAMIN BANK
ITEM NO.01
Diary No-115/2026
Dated: 13-01-2026
Shri Sanjay Shukla, counsel for the applicant is present.
Counsel argued that applicant had already deposited Rs. 47.00
lakh which is more than the Recovery Certificate amount of Rs.
3772825.00 hence the court fees is not applicable in this case.
Now this application be registered in Appeal Register.
The matter be listed before the Hon’ble Presiding Officer on
16.01.2026 for argument on court fee.
Assistant Registrar
